name: Voiceover Script
description: Writes a formatted voiceover script with conversational sentence length, emphasis marks, pause marks, pronunciation guides, and word count mapped to time estimates. Use when the user asks to write narration for a video, explainer, commercial, e-learning module, or any audio-only or audio-over-visual content. Do NOT use for on-camera video scripts with speaker direction (use video-script-writing), podcast episode content (use podcast-episode-planning), or presentation speaker notes (use speaker-notes-writing).
